checks.detail: Direct DOCX extraction matches all 30 estimates, all 28 CIs/levels, 2 reference conventions without CIs, units, sex/BMI/age labels and exact 1-based table row locators.
Task sex1=male and sex2=female maps through sex-1 to male/female parameter axis; arrays are sex x ascending age x ascending BMI (2x5x3), exactly matching source cells.

Array broadcasting logs - logs[:,:,0] - logs[:,0,:] + logs[:,0,0] implements D_s(a,b)=log[R_s(a,b)R_s(a0,b0)/(R_s(a,b0)R_s(a0,b))]. Source R and D are dimensionless; no mmol/L-to-mg/dL conversion is applied.

Both coordinates are clamped first; right-search indices are clipped to valid adjacent intervals. At either endpoint the interpolation weight is 0 or 1; within support weights stay in [0,1]. Bilinear interpolation uses four correctly oriented D vertices. D=0 on each reference line; at knots it equals the extracted D. Numeric knots/open-bin representatives and continuation are explicitly assumptions.

The final code constructs m=g(a,b0)g(a0,b)/g(a0,b0)*exp(D), not g(a,b)*exp(D). Because D(a,b0)=D(a0,b)=D(a0,b0)=0, both inherited reference-line curves are preserved and m(a,b)m(a0,b0)/(m(a,b0)m(a0,b))=exp(D). Identity is for within-sex legacy_proxy conditional means under the specified model; it does not reproduce full source R, arithmetic subgroup aggregates, or final unblanked assay cross-ratios.

All six existing numeric parameter groups are exactly equal. AST comparison confirms inherited positive-mean computation, residual-noise suffix and measurement function are unchanged. New structure changes off-reference-line means/marginal moments/effective coefficients, correctly disclosed.

Mean-one lognormal noise with constant within-sex log variance yields same geometric/arithmetic conditional ratios only on latent legacy_proxy scale. Final decision/spec/map correctly exclude the nonzero-intercept unblanked assay scale from this property.

Source ratio points/CIs are separated from category knots, full transfer, source variance/covariate marginalization and population/meal/assay assumptions. Male n and adjustment contradictions and asymmetric female interval are preserved. No covariance-based uncertainty is invented.

Decision/spec/map distinguish a source-informed structural sensitivity hypothesis from calibrated transport or target inference. All three analysis assessments remain partial, all links are components with declared differences. No full-source ratio-table, pooled-slope or marginal-moment reproduction claim remains.

Generator reads only observed age/sex/BMI/assay and supplied parameters/seed; no ID/cohort/count-conditioned biological coefficients, file/network/outcome access, optimizer, fit or parameter search. len(observed) only sizes residual draws. No generator import/execution, target/custody/execution artifacts, old scientific reports or agent inventory were inspected. Controller history and runtime correctness are outside this static audit.
